curated.caption: “I tawt I taw…” — air traffic controllers really named fixes after Tweety Bird.
“…I did!” — the punchline, sitting in the sky as a real waypoint.
BURGR. The FAA put a hamburger on the aeronautical charts.
SPICY. A real intersection you can file a flight plan through.
Pretzel, with the vowels taken out, the way fixes are.
DEZRT. Phonetically a desert, officially a navigation fix.
BOORD — bored, in five-letter flight-plan spelling.
Somebody named JAYME is, technically, forever in the sky.
